theorem imo_1969_p2

  (k : ℕ)
  (a : ℕ → ℝ)
  (y : ℝ → ℝ)
  (h₀ : 0 < k)

  (h₃ : y n = 0) :

  have h₅ : y n = 0 := h₃
  have h₆ : ∃ t : ℤ, m - n = t * π := by
    have h₇ : y m = y n := by rw [h₄, h₅]
    have h₈ : ∃ t : ℤ, m - n = t * π := by
      -- Use the fact that y is periodic with period 2π
      have h₉ : ∀ x, y (x + 2 * π) = y x := by
        intro x
        rw [h₁]
        apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
        intro i _
        have h₁₀ : Real.cos (a i + (x + 2 * π)) = Real.cos (a i + x) := by
          rw [Real.cos_add]
          ring_nf
          simp [Real.cos_two_pi]
        rw [h₁₀]
      -- Since y(m) = y(n), and y is periodic with period 2π, we can find an integer t such that m - n = t * π
      have h₁₀ : ∃ t : ℤ, m - n = t * π := by
        -- Use the fact that y is periodic with period 2π
        have h₁₁ : y m = y n := by rw [h₄, h₅]
        -- Since y is periodic with period 2π, we can find an integer t such that m - n = t * π
        have h₁₂ : ∃ t : ℤ, m - n = t * π := by
          -- Use the fact that y is periodic with period 2π
          have h₁₃ : y m = y n := by rw [h₄, h₅]
          -- Since y is periodic with period 2π, we can find an integer t such that m - n = t * π
          use 0
          linarith
        exact h₁₂
      exact h₁₀
    exact h₈
  exact h₆

theorem imo_1983_p6
  (a b c : ℝ)
  (h₀ : 0 < a ∧ 0 < b ∧ 0 < c)
  (h₁ : c < a + b)
  (h₂ : b < a + c)
  (h₃ : a < b + c) :
  0 ≤ a^2 * b * (a - b) + b^2 * c * (b - c) + c^2 * a * (c - a) := by
  have h₄ : a > 0 := h₀.1
  have h₅ : b > 0 := h₀.2.1
  have h₆ : c > 0 := h₀.2.2
  have h₇ : a + b > c := by linarith
  have h₈ : a + c > b := by linarith
  have h₉ : b + c > a := by linarith
  have h₁₀ : a^2 * b * (a - b) + b^2 * c * (b - c) + c^2 * a * (c - a) ≥ 0 := by
    cases' le_total a b with hab hab <;>
    cases' le_total b c with hbc hbc <;>
    cases' le_total c a with hac hac <;>
    simp_all [mul_assoc, mul_comm, mul_left_comm, sub_eq_add_neg, add_assoc, add_comm, add_left_comm]
    all_goals
    nlinarith [sq_nonneg (a - b), sq_nonneg (b - c), sq_nonneg (c - a),
      mul_pos h₄ h₅, mul_pos h₅ h₆, mul_pos h₆ h₄]
  exact h₁₀

theorem imo_1960_p2
  (x : ℝ)
  (h₀ : 0 ≤ 1 + 2 * x)
  (h₁ : (1 - Real.sqrt (1 + 2 * x))^2 ≠ 0)
  (h₂ : (4 * x^2) / (1 - Real.sqrt (1 + 2*x))^2 < 2*x + 9) :
  -(1 / 2) ≤ x ∧ x < 45 / 8 := by
  have h₃ : 0 < 1 - Real.sqrt (1 + 2 * x) := by
    have h₄ : Real.sqrt (1 + 2 * x) < 1 := by
      nlinarith [Real.sqrt_nonneg (1 + 2 * x), Real.sq_sqrt (show 0 ≤ 1 + 2 * x by linarith)]
    nlinarith [Real.sqrt_nonneg (1 + 2 * x), Real.sq_sqrt (show 0 ≤ 1 + 2 * x by linarith)]
  have h₄ : 0 < (1 - Real.sqrt (1 + 2 * x))^2 := by positivity
  have h₅ : 0 < 2 * x + 9 := by linarith
  have h₆ : x ≥ -1 / 2 := by
    by_contra h
    have h₇ : x < -1 / 2 := by linarith
    have h₈ : 4 * x ^ 2 > 0 := by nlinarith
    have h₉ : (1 - Real.sqrt (1 + 2 * x)) ^ 2 > 0 := by positivity
    have h₁₀ : (4 * x ^ 2) / (1 - Real.sqrt (1 + 2 * x)) ^ 2 > 0 := by positivity
    have h₁₁ : (4 * x ^ 2) / (1 - Real.sqrt (1 + 2 * x)) ^ 2 ≥ 2 * x + 9 := by
      have h₁₂ : (4 * x ^ 2) / (1 - Real.sqrt (1 + 2 * x)) ^ 2 ≥ 2 * x + 9 := by
        rw [div_le_iff (by positivity)]
        nlinarith [Real.sq_sqrt (show 0 ≤ 1 + 2 * x by linarith),
          Real.sqrt_nonneg (1 + 2 * x),
          sq_nonneg (x + 1 / 2)]
      linarith
    linarith
  have h₇ : x < 45 / 8 := by
    by_contra h
    have h₈ : x ≥ 45 / 8 := by linarith
    have h₉ : 4 * x ^ 2 ≥ 4 * (45 / 8) ^ 2 := by nlinarith
    have h₁₀ : (1 - Real.sqrt (1 + 2 * x)) ^ 2 > 0 := by positivity
    have h₁₁ : (4 * x ^ 2) / (1 - Real.sqrt (1 + 2 * x)) ^ 2 ≥ 2 * x + 9 := by
      have h₁₂ : (4 * x ^ 2) / (1 - Real.sqrt (1 + 2 * x)) ^ 2 ≥ 2 * x + 9 := by
        rw [div_le_iff (by positivity)]
        nlinarith [Real.sq_sqrt (show 0 ≤ 1 + 2 * x by linarith),
          Real.sqrt_nonneg (1 + 2 * x),
          sq_nonneg (x - 45 / 8)]

  have h₅ : 0 < c := h₀.2.2
  have h₆ : 9 * b = 20 * c := h₁

theorem imo_1963_p5 :
  Real.cos (π / 7) - Real.cos (2 * π / 7) + Real.cos (3 * π / 7) = 1 / 2 := by
  have h₁ : Real.cos (π / 7) - Real.cos (2 * π / 7) + Real.cos (3 * π / 7) = 1 / 2 := by
    rw [show Real.cos (π / 7) - Real.cos (2 * π / 7) + Real.cos (3 * π / 7) = 1 / 2 by
      have h₂ : Real.cos (π / 7) = (Real.cos (π / 7)) := rfl
      have h₃ : Real.cos (2 * π / 7) = (Real.cos (2 * π / 7)) := rfl
